card.name: Digits inside range boundaries in dosing tables
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 1, 2 or 3) that is the last or middle digit of a number at the start of a range or threshold in a dose or lab table. It appears just before 'to', a dash, 'kg', 'ms' or 'm²'.

modes.label: Body-size band lower bounds
modes.description: Final digit of the lower number in a body surface area or weight band.

modes.label: Other numeric ranges
modes.description: A digit within a range or cutoff in age, concentration or interval tables.

card.plain: It fires on a digit within the first number of a range in a dosing or lab table, such as 0.81 to 1.10 m² or 41 kg or more.
